name: Grappling Gun
body:
Price 5,000 gp; Slot —; Weight 10 lbs.; Capacity 1 grappling hook; Usage 1

DESCRIPTION

This high-tech device is the; size of a small pistol, and fires a small but sturdy grappling hook attached to 50 feet of hightensile silk or synthetic rope. The grappling hook is fired rapidly, with a range increment of 10 feet. A ranged touch attack must be made against the target to secure the grappling hook. A stationary object typically has a touch AC of 5, modified by its; size category. A grappling gun can only be fired once before needing to be rewound and reloaded, a process that takes 1 full minute.

A grappling gun used as an improvised weapon deals 1d4 piercing damage (1d3 if Small) and has the grapple special weapon quality.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Skill Checks Craft DC 22; Cost 2,500 gp; Craft Technological Item; Equipment production lab
